data.text:
The @MMDA  rolls out traffic management measures to improve the flow of vehicles entering and leaving Metro Manila, especially during the Christmas rush.

The concrete barriers at the intersection of Marcos Highway, near Gil Fernando Avenue and Felix Avenue, have been replaced with plastic barriers, according to MMDA chairperson Romando Artes on Thursday (Dec. 11, 2025).

This is intended to make it easier to open the intersection when traffic builds up, allowing motorists to move more quickly. | PTV photos
